claim: Circulation of Rs 500 notes will be discontinued from March 2026
note: The RBI notice only asked ATMs to also dispense Rs 100 and Rs 200 notes.

claim: Banks in India will be closed every Saturday and Sunday, as per new RBI rules.
RBI has banned cheques written in black ink from January 1st, 2025.
The Reserve Bank of India will soon issue a new ₹5000 note.
India will now exit the WHO, following the USA's footsteps.
note: Out of context: an old story about the US leaving the WHO, reshared as if India were following.

claim: A BBC anchor slammed India's Chandrayaan-3 mission, saying India has too much poverty to spend on space.

source.publisher: Alt News, BOOM and The Quint

note: Out of context: a 2019 clip from the Chandrayaan-2 mission, reshared in August 2023 as a reaction to Chandrayaan-3.

source.publisher: Business Standard (his family said he was alive in hospital)

note: Same Claim as true-dharmendra-died, judged as of the day of the hoax. He died on 24 November 2025.

claim: Every Indian must get an income tax clearance certificate before travelling abroad from 1 October 2024.
note: The certificate is only for people with big tax arrears or serious financial irregularities.

claim: India went from the 3rd largest economy in 2011 to the 164th fastest growing economy in 2021.
note: Compares size (PPP) with growth rate, and the 164th rank used old 2020 IMF projections.

claim: All UPI transactions above ₹2000 will have a 1.1% fee levied.
note: The 1.1% interchange fee applies to merchant payments made with prepaid wallets (PPIs), not ordinary bank-account UPI payments.

claim: 18% GST is applicable on education in India.
note: 18% applies to private coaching institutes; services of regular and vocational educational institutions are GST-free.

claim: GST on small cars in India is 28%.

source.publisher: Kotak Mutual Fund on GST Council's decision of 3 Sept 2025

note: True until 21 September 2025; GST 2.0 moved small cars to 18%.

claim: Sheikh Hasina is the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.
note: Resigned on 5 August 2024; Tarique Rahman was sworn in as Prime Minister on 17 February 2026.

claim: The RBI announced on 19 May 2023 that it was withdrawing the ₹2000 note from circulation.
Chandrayaan-3 landed near the Moon's south pole on 23 August 2023.
India's GST rate cuts took effect on 22 September 2025, removing the 12% and 28% slabs.

source.publisher: Kotak Mutual Fund on the GST Council's decision

note: Judged as of today; the same Claim was False on 11 Nov 2025.
